format: GP JSON using OMM field names (native CelesTrak API download, four satellites)
provenance_note: Native CelesTrak GP JSON, one query per satellite (gp.php?CATNR=<id>&FORMAT=JSON), retrieved on 2026-11-10. Records have different epochs: PULSAR-0, SES-5 and GALILEO 29 are fresh, QZS-2 (2026-10-17) is the oldest record available. No orbital model conversion was performed.

known_limitations: QZS-2 epoch is 2026-10-17: display epoch age and treat its common-window trajectory as a stale-data teaching example.
Kepler propagation of GP mean elements is an educational approximation.
The JSON eccentricity has more digits than the seven-digit TLE field; the two encodings describe the same element set.
